name: Wine (Red)
siboNotes: Alcohol can affect gut motility and may worsen SIBO symptoms. Limit to 1-2 glasses and consume with food to minimize digestive irritation.
preparationTips: Choose dry red wines over sweet varieties to minimize residual sugar
Consume with food to slow alcohol absorption
Stay hydrated by drinking water alongside wine
Avoid sulfite-sensitive reactions by choosing organic or low-sulfite wines
nutritionalHighlights: May support heart health in moderation
